test_cases.name: 038_05_01 Create Context Source Registration Subscription With expiresAt Member
test_cases.doc: Check that you can create a context source registration subscription with an expiresAt member and when it is due the status of the subscription changes to "expired"
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceSubscriptions/{subscription_id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Context Source Registration Subscription with data: and
    Query Parameter: subscription id set to '${subscription_id}'
}
